scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm run start --prefix server
scripts.start:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run start --prefix server
scripts.deploy:prepare: npm run install:all && npm run build
